_help: Skills range from 0 to 5. 'group' is physical, mental or social.

skills.name: Agility
skills.description: The ability to move nimbly and gracefully and to apply dexterity.
skills.examples: Climbing, throwing something precisely, chasing someone on foot

skills.name: Crafting
skills.description: Using, understanding, modifying and making items and mechanisms.

skills.name: Influence
skills.description: Influencing others and your surroundings. Resistance against social effects.
skills.examples: Lying to a guard, haggling with a merchant, fishing for information in a conversation

skills.name: Insight
skills.description: Understanding yourself and others, reading people and situations. Resistance against mental effects.
skills.examples: Understanding a magical effect, understanding the intention of someone you are talking to

skills.name: Lore
skills.description: Processing and passing on information, doing mental work.
skills.examples: Quickly searching a book for information, remembering a story, interpreting a prophecy

skills.name: Might
skills.description: Physical toughness and strength. Resistance against physical effects.
skills.examples: Swimming, holding someone down, moving or throwing something heavy, melee attacks with heavy weapons

skills.name: Performance
skills.description: Putting on a show, artistically and physically.

skills.name: Trickery
skills.description: Secrecy and caution – everything to do with the non-obvious and steady hands.
skills.examples: Pickpocketing, sleight of hand, sneaking and hiding, picking locks

skills.name: Vigilance
skills.examples: Searching for clues, keeping watch, tasting poison in a drink, spotting someone in a crowd
